capabilities.name: Buy a car, home or travel policy
capabilities.question: Can you buy a car, home or travel insurance policy from start to finish in a chat with an AI agent?

US.note: Lemonade's AI bot Maya quotes and sells renters and home policies in a chat in its app. The Insurify, Experian and Liberty Mutual apps in ChatGPT give car insurance quotes, but you finish buying on their sites or the insurer's.

evidence.title: The Ultimate Lemonade Renters & Homeowners FAQ
Insurify expands ChatGPT plugin with real-time personalized quotes and in-chat shopping
Experian launches insurance marketplace app on ChatGPT
Liberty Mutual launches carrier-backed conversational AI quoting app in ChatGPT for auto insurance

GB.note: Lemonade's AI bot Maya asks you a few questions in a chat and sells contents and home cover in its UK app. The MoneySuperMarket and Go.Compare apps in ChatGPT give car and home quotes, but you buy on their sites.

evidence.title: What is an insurance quote?
Home insurance starting at £4
New MoneySuperMarket ChatGPT app
Go.Compare launches ChatGPT app to help consumers find a great deal on their insurance

DE.note: Lemonade sells contents and personal liability cover in its German app and website, but no German page we found says its AI bot Maya runs the sign-up, so we score it lower.

evidence.title: Hausrat & Privathaftpflichtversicherung FAQ
Lemonade: Hausrat und Privathaftpflicht schnell per App abschließen
Insurtech Lemonade: KI und Anti-Fraud-Checks

IN.note: PolicyX's Pixie chatbot (December 2025) gives live quotes and compares plans from more than 50 insurers, but it hands complex cases to an advisor and does not complete the purchase in the chat.

evidence.title: PolicyX launches Pixie, India's first AI insurance chatbot
PiXie, your AI insurance assistant

BR.note: HUBSEGS sells insurance entirely on WhatsApp with generative AI, from quote to a digital policy in the chat, in under three minutes, for brokers and their clients.

evidence.title: HUBSEGS comercializa seguros 100% pelo WhatsApp
HUBSEGS vende seguros pelo WhatsApp com GenAI

MX.note: We found no insurer, comparison site or AI assistant app that sells a policy in a chat in Mexico; most policies are still sold through human intermediaries.

evidence.title: Aseguradoras necesitan atender WhatsApp

CL.note: Líder Bci sells insurance on WhatsApp with conversational AI, from quote to payment and policy issue in two to three minutes, starting with the SOAP mandatory car insurance (May 2025).

evidence.title: Líder Bci habilita contratación de seguros por WhatsApp

CO.note: We found no AI that sells a policy in a chat in Colombia. The digital agency Seguro Canguro uses AI only to check car policy documents before it sends the policy.

evidence.title: La inteligencia artificial reduce a minutos la revisión de pólizas en Colombia: así funciona

capabilities.name: File an insurance claim
capabilities.question: Can an insurer's AI agent take your claim in a chat, file it and move it forward, not only answer questions?

US.note: Lemonade's AI Jim takes renters, home, car and pet claims in a chat in its app, pays some instantly and passes the rest to a person.

evidence.title: How Lemonade's tech-powered claims work
The Ultimate Lemonade Renters & Homeowners FAQ
How to file a car insurance claim
How to file a pet insurance claim

GB.note: In Lemonade's UK app you tell AI Jim about your claim in a chat; it approves and pays simple claims at once and passes the rest to a person.

evidence.title: Making an insurance claim
New UK record? Lemonade pays claim in two seconds

DE.note: In Lemonade's German app, "Schaden melden" opens a chat with AI Jim, which takes the claim through every step.

evidence.title: So meldest du einen Schaden bei Lemonade

IN.note: HDFC ERGO's WhatsApp chatbot registers motor claims, runs an AI photo inspection and settles minor damage claims up to Rs 20,000 straight to your bank account.

evidence.title: Know how to get your instant motor claim settlement via WhatsApp

BR.note: Porto's conversational AI agent on WhatsApp lets policyholders across Brazil open and finish a car theft claim, and it handles 70% of those claims (October 2026). Mapfre's AI agent on WhatsApp and EZZE's AI chat assistant also open car claims.

evidence.title: Porto automatiza 70% dos sinistros de roubo e furto
EZZE Seguros amplia IA e corta etapas e ligações nos sinistros Auto
MAPFRE implementa primeira jornada de sinistro 100% resolutiva por IA no WhatsApp

MX.note: Quálitas's Quali-bot on WhatsApp answers claim questions, collects documents and sends you to Ajuste Express to send photos, but we found no AI that files or moves the claim. The only source is written by Blip, the bot's maker.

evidence.title: Aseguradoras necesitan atender WhatsApp

CL.note: We found no Chilean insurer whose AI takes and moves a claim in a chat; Líder Bci's WhatsApp AI sells policies, but we found nothing on claims.

CO.note: BNP Paribas Cardif Colombia handles claims on WhatsApp: its AI reads and checks the documents you send and decides whether the claim stays automated or goes to an advisor (May 2023).

evidence.title: Aseguradora utiliza la IA para la evaluación y pagos de pólizas
